sections.label: BLANK STOCK
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. `text` is the on-screen copy for this beat, not spoken words.

enhancement_cues.description: Bone stock. Crop marks snap to four corners in sequence. Colour-calibration bar draws L→R along the top edge. Margin micro-type sets.

sections.label: KEY PLATE
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. `text` is the on-screen copy for this beat, not spoken words.

enhancement_cues.description: Black key plate slams down: type only, huge, bleeding both edges. Registration crosshairs flash once.

sections.label: MISREGISTER
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. `text` is the on-screen copy for this beat, not spoken words.

enhancement_cues.description: Crimson plate drops 14px off-register. Ghosted double-edge under the black. Jitters twice.

sections.label: SNAP
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. `text` is the on-screen copy for this beat, not spoken words.

enhancement_cues.description: Plate registers with a hard click. A crimson bar rockets across the frame and stops dead. PROTOCOL lands beneath SHINJUKU.

sections.label: WINDOW OPENS
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. `text` is the on-screen copy for this beat, not spoken words.

enhancement_cues.description: Roller wipe cuts an image-window into the sheet. A band only — the hand, the glass. Halftone dots at the window edge.

sections.label: DUOTONE FLIP
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. `text` is the on-screen copy for this beat, not spoken words.

enhancement_cues.description: The window flips full-colour → crimson/ink duotone → back, on the beat. Plate label ticks over.

sections.label: TYPE THROUGH ARTWORK
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. `text` is the on-screen copy for this beat, not spoken words.

enhancement_cues.description: SIGNATURE SHOT. Full-bleed SHINJUKU, letterforms filled with the poster artwork, everything else bone. Letters track out slowly.

sections.label: COLD INVERSION
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. `text` is the on-screen copy for this beat, not spoken words.

enhancement_cues.description: Ink field. Cold cyan reticle, grid and coordinates draw on. Small image window centred.

sections.label: TRIPTYCH
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. `text` is the on-screen copy for this beat, not spoken words.

enhancement_cues.description: Three vertical panels slide in at different speeds — the three poster treatments. Rotated side-bar type on each.

sections.label: ROLLER WIPE
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. `text` is the on-screen copy for this beat, not spoken words.

enhancement_cues.description: A hard-edged crimson roller sweeps across, leaving PROTOCOL knocked out in white. Halftone density ramps under it.

sections.label: ASSEMBLY
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. `text` is the on-screen copy for this beat, not spoken words.

enhancement_cues.description: All four plates converge on four beats — stock, key, crimson, image. Barcode draws in.

sections.label: LOCKUP
sections.speaker_directions: No narration. `text` is the on-screen copy for this beat, not spoken words.

enhancement_cues.description: Dead still. Full poster lockup: crop marks, colour bar, barcode, date, coordinates, ►►►. One halftone shimmer settles over 0.4s, then nothing moves.
